narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Twenty two and six are not multiples of four, so their sum cannot be a multiple of four.
<bookmark mark='extra'/>Look at the leftover chairs. Each number leaves two over.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Two leftovers together might fill a row, so we must look again.

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Two numbers that each leave two over make a full row together.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Six and ten each leave two over in rows of four. Is six plus ten a multiple of four?
